venues.priorBlockerResolution: The SCHEMA HOLD rested on the two unnumbered wheelchair spaces and the published 1,808. Under the current guide that difference is confidence metadata. The chart's vector text layer yields exactly 1,808 printed numbers and reconciles with every issuer floor subtotal.
venues.ownershipResolution: The sajiki columns and the 2F/3F side blocks carry no printed floor or area name. Their floor is not inferred from drawing position: 2F main 393 + side boxes 48 = the issuer's 441, and 3F main 440 + side strips 30 = the issuer's 470, so the issuer's own arithmetic fixes the floor. Area names (1階西桟敷, 2階西側ボックス席, 3階西側席 and their east counterparts) are repository-defined display names and are disclosed as such.

The seat cells were extracted from the PDF's own vector drawing: the first floor holds exactly 1,242 cells across 32 rows and the second floor exactly 560 across 21 rows, both matching the figures printed on the drawing. The recorded reading of 1,258 first-floor cells does not reproduce; it came from ignoring the row rake when connecting the side cells.
venues.displayAreaDeviation: The instruction was to model the first-floor side block as an independent display area. It is instead kept inside its row, because the issuer numbers each row continuously 1-44 across all blocks and the connection is now verifiable against the issuer's own 1,242. Splitting it would have required inventing an area name for seats the issuer numbers as one row. Flagged for the user; reversible without new evidence.
